answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by anchoring peer verification to a trusted kernel that enforces collateralized interaction graphs. Transactions refract through a reputation prism where each agent must stake capital to endorse newly minted identities. If Sybil identities coordinate to spoof consensus, correlated behavior triggers automatic slashing, and the offending keys are logged to a permanent sable blacklist. The linear capital expenditure and irrevocable slashing cost make mass counterfeit identities unprofitable for an attacker.
